research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: PlanetScale is advancing database technology by developing a caching layer that resolves data races and deduplicates rows between upqueries and updates, enhancing SQL query performance with write order consistency. Additionally, they are innovating in database management by enabling schema branching workflows, allowing users to create and edit branches of a main database schema, and merge changes back efficiently. These efforts focus on improving database performance and flexibility, aligning with their core offering of a database-as-a-service built on Vitess.

overview_description.description:
PlanetScale is a fully managed database platform for Vitess/MySQL and Postgres, delivering NVMe-backed performance, massive scale through horizontal sharding, and enterprise-grade reliability.

Our serverless database platform is built on the tested scalability of Vitess. With predictable scale, workflow velocity, and the ability to deploy features without downtime, we empower development teams to do more with their time. 

PlanetScale created Vitess, a MySQL sharding solution powering products such as YouTube, Slack, Square and many more. PlanetScale’s expertise helps such businesses scale their new and existing infrastructure faster.

product.name: PlanetScale Vitess
product.description: A horizontally scalable MySQL database system using explicit sharding to distribute data across multiple nodes, managed through a single database connection.

product.name: PlanetScale Metal
product.description: A cloud database service running on dedicated servers with NVMe drives, providing high IOPS and low latency for database workloads.

product.name: PlanetScale for Postgres
product.description: A managed cloud database service offering PostgreSQL clusters with high availability and performance.

product.name: PlanetScale Database Management Platform
product.description: A platform providing database management features such as branching, deploy requests, schema change rollbacks, and query performance insights.

product.name: PlanetScale Managed
product.description: An enterprise deployment option allowing customers to run PlanetScale databases in their own cloud environments with managed services.
